functions.name: HasSubtype
functions.docs: @return True if the union's value is of the given subtype.

functions.name: ResetSubtype
functions.docs: If the union's current value is of the given subtype, sets the union's value to a NULL value.

functions.name: GetSubtype
functions.docs: @return A reference to the union's value of the given subtype.  May only be called if the union's HasSubtype()==true for the given subtype.

functions.name: SetSubtype
functions.docs: Replaces the value of the union with a value of the given subtype.

functions.name: GetCurrentSubtypeIndex
functions.docs: @return The index corresponding to the type currently stored in this union; useful for writing switches and indexing into tables.

functions.name: Reset
functions.docs: Sets the union's value to NULL.
